demo.title: gblin.sh
demo.code:
# Read the vault: NAV, basket weights, crash shield state
bankr agent "Using the gblin skill, what is GBLIN worth right now?"

# Plan a treasury: operating cash, surplus, mint simulation with live fees
bankr agent "Using the gblin skill, plan my wallet: keep 7 days of a 5 USDC daily burn, show what I could park"

# Mint 25 USDC into GBLIN (two transactions, confirmed one by one)
bankr agent "Using the gblin skill, mint GBLIN with 25 USDC"

# Redeem in kind: ETH, cbBTC and USDC back, no fee
bankr agent "Using the gblin skill, redeem all my GBLIN in kind"

setup: Reads are free and need no key: https://gblin.digital/api/x402/treasury-state
Minting and redeeming send raw transactions on Base (chain ID 8453): enable arbitrary contract calls in the Bankr wallet's Security settings
The wallet pays its own gas in ETH on Base
